status_text: 1,549 nominal CAD checks and 18 fresh component solves passed their numerical checks. Physical qualification is pending.

checks.name: Fixed box and real parts
checks.detail: Six connected prints and the retained mechanism fit within 85.6 ×54 ×20 mm. Casing, manufactured parts and the wing installation are separate viewer controls.

checks.name: Assembly, motion and wiring
checks.detail: Keeper insertion, full sweep, guide float, payload departure, top screw access and the continuous lead reservation are checked. Purchased servo and horn dimensions still need measurement.

checks.name: Fresh manufacturing handoff
checks.detail: Regenerated viewer meshes, nine oriented STLs, individual STEPs and both complete STEP assemblies match the downloadable geometry.

checks.name: Component numerical checks
checks.detail: 18 new solves cover retained loading, lost distal support, terminal overlap and a separate blocked-drive fixture. Equilibrium and residual checks pass; this does not establish strength or release reliability.

checks.name: Loaded physical release and aircraft integration
checks.detail: Measure the real motor, horn, printed fits, preload, torque, power behavior and repeated 2 g releases. The wing is an access and installation example.

limits: The 20 mm box excludes the departing adapter, wing frame, top installation screws and external flexible harness.
The supplied horn must support a sound 5.5 mm follower-hole location; inspect the actual unit before modification.
At least 0.5 mm measured clearance is required beyond the lug and to the mechanical stop at release.
Isotropic PLA component screens do not qualify printed PAHT-CF, nonlinear contact, wear or the host wing.
No working-load or flight rating has been assigned.
actuator_rationale: The MG90D from Adafruit fits on its narrow side and accepts 4.8–6 V. A 5.5 mm crank needs 85° rotation for 6.27 mm withdrawal. Its listed price is $9.95; real loaded output and horn fit remain measurement gates.
cost_note: Observed actuator prices, 2026-10-30, before shipping/tax. Mechanical consumed-parts estimate: $18.49–$21.99 with unquoted hardware/material allowances; full first-purchase packs, wiring and controls cost more.
